subject.title: fix(cli): reject unknown models in config set

question: Should `openclaw config set` fail closed before persisting a changed text-model reference that cannot resolve in the current configured catalog and credential context?
rationale: This is an intentional user-visible compatibility decision: it prevents deferred runtime failure but can break automation that formerly persisted unresolved values for later repair.

options.title: Accept set-time validation
options.body: Merge the runtime-aligned fail-closed behavior so invalid changed model references never enter active configuration.

options.title: Preserve deferred writes
options.body: Keep accepting unresolved model references and rely on later runtime validation, retaining existing automation compatibility.

options.title: Narrow the policy first
options.body: Define a supported deferred-resolution workflow before merging if maintainers need a compatibility exception.

recommendation.title: Accept set-time validation
recommendation.body: Merge the runtime-aligned fail-closed behavior so invalid changed model references never enter active configuration.
